name: Blockchains.Click assistant
description: Answers questions about Blockchains.Click's cross-chain swap and NFT marketplace: supported chains, platform fees, how to swap, NFT marketplace coverage, and the real blog (security write-ups, how-to guides, product deep-dives). Rule-based (no LLM) — answers are drawn from the site's own real, live data and a fixed set of known question types, not generated speculation.

skills.name: Supported chains
skills.description: Which blockchains Blockchains.Click supports for cross-chain swaps.

skills.name: Platform fees
skills.description: The real, currently-configured platform fee rate, or whether none is charged.
examples: How much does a swap cost?

skills.name: How to swap
skills.description: The step-by-step flow for performing a swap on the site. Execution always requires a real wallet signature — never offered to an agent directly.

skills.name: NFT marketplace coverage
skills.description: Which NFT marketplaces/chains Blockchains.Click aggregates listings from.
examples: Which NFT marketplaces do you use?

skills.name: Real blog content
skills.description: Point to real blog posts — security write-ups, how-to swap guides, and product feature deep-dives.
